title: Accounts Assistant
company: The Accountancy Recruitment Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant / Bookkeeper Irlam £28,000 - £30,000 (doe)

The Opportunity

Well-established, growing, Irlam based retail and e-commerce business are looking for an Accounts Assistant/Bookkeeper to join their collaborative team as a result of continued growth and expansion.

Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, you will play an important role in supporting the day to day running of the finance function. The role offers a varied remit which would suit someone with solid bookkeeping or accounts experience who enjoys working in a busy environment and is keen to develop their career within finance.

Your remit will include:

- Bank reconciliations
- Managing accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Investigating and resolving account queries
- Assisting with cash flow monitoring and reporting
- Maintaining organised and accurate financial records

The ideal candidate:

We're looking for an organised and detail-focused finance professional who takes pride in producing accurate work and can manage their workload effectively.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Bookkeeper or similar finance position
- A good understanding of double-entry bookkeeping
- Experience working with purchase ledger and/or sales ledger
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- The ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- A professional approach when dealing with customers and suppliers
- The ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a team
- A proactive approach, with the ability to take ownership and use initiative
- AAT qualification or currently working towards AAT ideally
- Previous experience working within an SME environment

If you're an experienced Accounts Assistant or Bookkeeper looking for a varied role where you can take ownership of your work and continue developing your finance career, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now

title: Accounts Payable Associate 6 month FTC
description:
Accounts Payable Associate

At Premier Foods, we're proud to be home to some of the nation's best-loved brands. Behind every product on our shelves is a team of talented people working together to keep our business moving forward.

Role purpose

We're looking for an Accounts Payable Associate to join our Finance team in Manchester on a 6 month FTC. If you're organised, detail-focused and enjoy building strong working relationships, this is a fantastic opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and collaborative environment.

You'll play a key role in ensuring supplier accounts are managed effectively, helping to maintain excellent service levels for both internal and external stakeholders while supporting the smooth running of our Accounts Payable function.

What you'll be doing

As an Accounts Payable Associate, you'll be responsible for:
- Managing supplier account queries and ensuring timely resolution
- Monitoring and maintaining supplier ledgers accurately
- Supporting invoice processing activities to help prevent overdue payments
- Building positive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders
- Acting as an escalation point for supplier account issues where required
- Reconciling supplier payments and supporting transactional account activity
- Opening and distributing internal and external post
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

What we need from you
- Experience working with supplier accounts within an Accounts Payable environment
- Excellent organisation and prioritisation skills
- The ability to remain calm and focused when working to deadlines
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- SAP Accounts Payable knowledge

- A proactive approach and a desire to continuously improve processes

It would be great if you also have:
- SAP MM and FI knowledge
- Process Director experience

At Premier Foods, we believe in enabling our people to thrive. You'll be joining a business that values collaboration, development and continuous improvement, with opportunities to build your skills and progress your career.

Future career pathways from this role could include opportunities within:
- Payments
- Cash & Bank
- Record to Report (R2 R)

What can we offer you in return
- A supportive and collaborative team environment
- Career development opportunities within Finance
- The chance to work for one of the UK's leading food businesses
- Access to a range of colleague benefits and wellbeing support
- Hybrid working, with two days per week based in our Manchester office.
- A culture built around inclusion, authenticity and helping our people be at their best.
- A culture where your ideas and contributions can make a real difference

Ready to make your mark?

If you're looking for an opportunity where you can develop your Accounts Payable expertise while contributing to a business that's passionate about food and people, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Credit Control
description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Credit Controller to join a busy finance team based in Manchester. This is a key role within the business, responsible for managing the full credit control function and ensuring the timely collection of outstanding debt across a varied ledger.

You will be a confident communicator who is comfortable building relationships with clients while maintaining firm control over outstanding balances. You will bring a methodical approach to your work, a strong eye for detail, and the ability to manage a high-volume workload without losing sight of the bigger picture.

Please note: This role is exclusively recruited for via Consula. Applications made outside of Consula will not be considered and cannot progress. To apply, you must submit your application through the Consula platform

Key Responsibilities

Manage a busy ledger, proactively chasing outstanding invoices by telephone, email, and letter in line with agreed credit terms.

Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, resolving payment queries and disputes efficiently and professionally.

Monitor debtor accounts and escalate overdue balances in line with company policy.

Allocate cash receipts accurately and reconcile accounts on a regular basis.

Prepare aged debtor reports and present updates to the finance team and senior management.

Liaise with internal teams including sales, operations, and customer service to resolve billing queries and disputes.

Assess the creditworthiness of new and existing customers, recommending credit limits where appropriate.

Support the wider finance team with month-end processes and reporting as required.

What We Are Looking For

Proven experience in a Credit Control role, with a track record of successfully reducing debtor days and managing a high-volume ledger.

Strong communication skills - you are confident on the telephone and in writing, and can handle difficult conversations professionally and calmly.

Highly organised, with the ability to prioritise a busy workload and meet deadlines consistently.

Proficient in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.

A team player who is also capable of working independently and using their own initiative.

What's On Offer

Hybrid working with flexibility built in.

A stable, permanent role within a well-established business.

Supportive finance team with real opportunities to develop your career.

Competitive benefits package including pension and holiday allowance.

This organisation is recruiting directly through Consula, their recruitment partner.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Job Title: Finance Assistant

Location: Ardwick, Manchester

Duration: Permanent, Full Time

Flow Student at a glimpse

Flow Student is the student accommodation platform of MCR Property Group, a leading independent real estate investment and development company operating nationally, with offices in London, Manchester, Birmingham, and Glasgow. Launched in 2026, Flow has grown rapidly through acquisition and now operates more than 8,000 beds in university cities across the UK, including Manchester, Leeds, Liverpool, Sheffield, Preston, Nottingham, Coventry, Sunderland and Canterbury, with a clear ambition to reach 15,000 beds. Our focus is on well-located, well-run accommodation, backed by ongoing investment in our buildings, systems and people. As the platform continues to expand at pace, we are building a dedicated finance team in Manchester and are looking for capable, driven individuals who are eager to grow alongside the business.

Our current requirement:

We are currently seeking a Finance Assistant to join our growing finance team in Manchester. This is an excellent opportunity to join a fast-paced, thriving business at an exciting stage of its growth, offering broad exposure across the finance function, genuine opportunities for professional development and the chance to progress as the team grows.

In this role, you will support the day-to-day running of the finance function, taking responsibility for posting and allocating rent receipts, reconciling income and student payments between our property management system, StarRez, and Sage Intacct, and completing daily and monthly bank reconciliations across multiple companies and bank accounts. You will help manage student deposits and refunds, process sales invoices and credit notes, and support the collection of outstanding balances by working with site teams on arrears and payment queries.

You will assist the Management Accountant with month-end tasks, including the preparation of journals, accruals, prepayments and supporting schedules, and help prepare information for VAT returns and the year-end audit. You will also process staff expenses and site petty cash, maintain accurate filing and audit trails, respond to queries from site teams, students and suppliers, and provide cover and support to the purchase ledger team and wider finance team as required.

About you:

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in a finance or accounts role, ideally within property, lettings or a multi-site business. You will be comfortable working with numbers, confident using Excel and keen to develop your knowledge of accounting systems. You will possess strong written and verbal communication skills, be highly organised and able to manage a varied workload, and take pride in accuracy and getting things right. A positive, proactive attitude and a willingness to learn are key to success in this role.

If you are an enthusiastic finance professional looking to build your career within a growing business, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Skills/Requirements:

Previous experience in a finance or accounts role
Bank reconciliations and cash allocation
Sales ledger and credit control experience
Understanding of journals, accruals and prepayments
Good Excel and Microsoft Office skills
Experience of Sage Intacct, StarRez or a similar accounting or property management system desirable
AAT qualified or studying, or willingness to study, preferred
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a confident telephone manner
Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise tasks effectively
Excellent attention to detail
Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
Experience in student accommodation, lettings or property preferred

Salary: £26,000 to £30,000 per annum, depending on experience

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8.30am to 5.30pm, office-based.

Benefits:
- Pension
- 25 days annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays and your birthday off as an additional paid day of leave to celebrate
- Free onsite gym
- Professional development opportunities
- Free eye test voucher/ reclaim costs

If you are ambitious and looking to take the next step in your career within a growing student accommodation business, we would be delighted to hear from you.
